## What landed

**(1) `provider_tool_api` deferral flags on both minimal profiles
(DF-S1.17-1).** `minimal-patch` and `minimal-string-replace` declare
`deferred_tools: Unknown` and `tool_search: Unknown` on their
`ProfileCapabilities` record (`crates/hh-compiler/src/profile.rs`) —
named capability-record members, not generic registry-row fields;
`unknown` is the fail-closed C0 spelling of unsupported, never a
guessed `declared`. The capability-state codec already owned the
spelling — the flags round-trip the wire (`r3_5_minimal_profile_flags_round_trip_the_codec`).

**(2) The provider artefact carries the deferral block + the loss gate.**
`lower_provider` emits `deferral{deferred_tools, tool_search}` on the
`hh-provider-request/1` artefact — the bound leaf profile's states
verbatim (`declared | probed | unknown`, never coerced) — and each tool
entry carries `deferrable` (the binding's `admitted_modes ∋ deferred`)
(`crates/hh-compiler/src/target.rs`). A `deferrable` surface under an
unestablished `deferred_tools` records a declared `no_slot`/`narrowed`
loss naming the unestablished capability — the refusal shape §3.2.5
owns, never a silent direct-only narrowing. A declared capability
expresses the leg clean — no loss entry
(`r3_5_deferrable_under_unknown_declares_no_slot_loss` /
`r3_5_deferrable_under_declared_capability_carries_flag_clean`).

**(3) `surface_rejection_rate` computes — the one fold (CC1;
AC-R-2.5.2-12).** The catalogue row's fold flipped `N(Capability) → C`
(`crates/hh-telemetry/src/catalogue.rs`); `compute_metric` gains the
branch (`crates/hh-telemetry/src/views.rs`): `surface_rejected ÷
model-emitted calls`, calls deduped on the `tool_call` scope
(scope-then-payload — the env pattern mints `proposed` before the
arg-eval refusal's `surface_rejected` on the same id); the stratum key
is `{profile}|{family}` — `profile` joins the producing
`model.call.requested`'s `profile_ref` (`model_ref.profile_ref`
second), `family` reads the payload member the emitters stamp from the
binding's `family_id`. Both read `unknown` absent — never fabricated.
An empty denominator renders `n/a{estimator_undefined}`; hosted
participants read `n/a{class}` through the existing class gate
(`crates/hh-telemetry/tests/r3_5.rs` — 5 legs over durable
`Store`-appended envelopes, never a mock metric store).

**(4) `family` rides the emitted rows end-to-end.**
`action.tool.proposed` and `action.tool.surface_rejected` payloads gain
the optional `family` member (`crates/hh-env/src/events.rs`); the
dispatcher stamps `binding.family_id` (`crates/hh-env/src/dispatch.rs` —
the synthetic `hh:message_human` elicitation stamps `null` honestly).
The control plane carries it on `SurfaceSpec.family: Option<String>`
(`crates/hh-control/src/output.rs`): the driver's proposal mint and the
guard's parser-reject row stamp it off the surface record
(`driver.rs`, `guards.rs`), `null` when the attempted name never bound;
the `leaf.arm` record round-trips it verbatim
(`crates/hh-embed/src/open.rs` — `surface_json`/`surface_from_json`,
pinned by `open::tests::r3_5_surface_family_round_trips_the_arm_record`).
Host-cap surfaces (`supplies.host_capabilities[]`) carry no `family_id`
in the schema — `family: None` is the honest spelling there, never a
guess. `SurfaceRejected` gains the same member in the compiler's
payload shape (`crates/hh-compiler/src/surface.rs`).

**(5) ADR-0272 leg (a) — `sync_source` → `adopt` over a real delta.**
`r3_5_sync_source_adopts_catalog_delta` compiles a fixture doc, builds
the catalog, then runs `sync_source` under `list_changed` on a listing
that drops one surface and lifts one new one: the delta names both
halves, `adopt` mints `epoch + 1` with `authority = unverified` on the
`bundle_delta` descriptors, the removed surface leaves the catalog,
the lifted surface joins, the source row records the new snapshot, and
both `action.tool.catalog.{delta,epoch}` payloads emit. The existing
S3.9 matrix covers the six triggers; this leg pins the adopt half so
removing it fails here.

**(6) ADR-0272 leg (b) — `retrieval_eval` real baselines + the floor
verdict.** `crates/hh-bench/tests/r3_5.rs` runs `retrieval_eval` over
the committed `benchset.stage3.v1` corpus (the ≥200-entry catalogue; 46
labelled queries over 23 recorded tasks): `exact_name` recall@8 =
nDCG@8 = **1.0000** — the pre-registered floor re-verified
(AC-R-2.5.3-11). The scope question is answered on the *same*
exact-name set: `bm25` and `hierarchical` both meet the floor
(1.0000/1.0000) — **no underperformance; the floor's scope stands**.
`bm25`/NL, `hierarchical`/namespace-path and
`lexical_regex`/anchored-name arms each record 1.0000/1.0000; the
observed baselines are pinned in the battery so a regression trips.
ADR-0272's revisit trigger carries the dated fired-answered note — legs
(c)/(d) re-checked and answer fired too: (c) DF-S2.9-3's automatic
snapshot cadence landed at R2.4 (the takes ride `KernelSink` inside the
armed run, never the CLI takeover session — D6's keep-open stands);
(d) AC-R-2.11.1-16 landed at S2.12 (`emit_result` gates `hh compact`
output — withheld items render the typed tombstone and
`loss_report.dropped[]` enumerates omitted classes). All four legs
answered — ADR-0272 discharged to BL-43.
